title: Transitions
summary: GPU shader transitions in the theme's look, shown going from the cold-graded sample clip to a title card: seven of its own (a flicker cut, a dip to black with a slow fade up, a vertical streak smear, a signal loss, a lamp failure, a cold melt, a creeping shadow) and eight from the shared set, drawn in the theme's colours (fog grey and cold blue in place of the shared cyan and amber). Atmosphere only.
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "black_dip", "seconds": 0.9}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "flicker_cut", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.5}]. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl); this theme's own shaders and its colours for the shared ones are in transitions/theme_transitions.py.

items.name: black dip
items.description: The shot drops quickly into black, the black holds, and the next comes up slowly, shadows last. The theme default.

items.name: flicker cut
items.description: The light flickers between the two shots (full, half, out), is out for a beat in the middle, and the next shot wins.

items.name: lamp out
items.description: The lamp fails: the light sputters and shrinks to a pool, goes out, and after a beat strikes again, unsteadily, on the next shot.

items.name: shadow creep
items.description: Shadow creeps over the frame from the top corner in soft, uneven fingers; the next shot comes out of the dark behind it.

items.name: streak smear
items.description: The shot comes apart into vertical streaks that smear, thin and go out, the way the theme's lettering leaves; the next assembles in reverse.

items.name: cold melt
items.description: A slow melt: the picture sags and swims as if seen through cold water, drains to blue-grey and becomes the next shot through mist.

items.name: luma melt
items.description: The outgoing shot drips down the frame in columns while its bright areas burn through first, with a cold blue fringe.

items.name: noise dissolve
items.description: Three sizes of noise eat the picture away.

items.name: pixel dissolve
items.description: The picture drops to coarser and coarser blocks, swaps, and resolves again.

items.name: signal loss
items.description: The signal goes: rows tear sideways, colour drops out, grey static takes the frame with a rolling dark bar, and the next shot locks in.

items.name: tube switch-off
items.description: The shot switches off like an old television (a line, then a dot) and the next one switches on.

items.name: datamosh
items.description: Blocks freeze, smear along their motion and are replaced out of order.

items.name: push through
items.description: The camera flies through the outgoing shot into the next one.

items.name: doors
items.description: The shot splits down the middle into two doors that swing open on what lies beyond.

items.name: slices
items.description: The shot is cut into horizontal slices that slide off to alternate sides.
